description: Answer questions about what happened over a past time window at home or with connected devices and vehicles: where family members have been (location history), distance a vehicle travelled (odometer change), how often or when a sensor, camera, doorbell or door last triggered (event counts, last activity), durations and numeric trends. Find the entity first, then read its history over the window.
examples: How many miles did the Mustang drive yesterday?
How long was the garage door open last night?
What was the temperature in the nursery overnight?
When did the front door last open?
How much energy did the house use this month?
Where did my car go yesterday?
How many hours was the heater on today?
When did I get home last night?
Show me the humidity trend in the basement this week
How many times did the doorbell ring today?
When was the last time the dishwasher ran?
What time did the lights go off last night?
When did the front door camera last detect someone
How many motion events did the doorbell record today
negatives: What is the temperature in the nursery right now?
Email me last month's electricity bill
